comparison.objective: Vent a vacuum desiccator gently, load a vial while holding the dome, reseal it, pump down, isolate the vacuum, and stop the pump; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-687 tests rate-controlled valve operation, gauge-guided sequencing, bimanual lid/sample handling, sealing, and switch operation; the candidate tests precision tool seating and coupled screw/nut torque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-687 requires the vial on its ring, a seated dome, pressure at or below -90 kPa, closed stopcock, pump off, and limited vent rate; the candidate requires angle accuracy and repeated mechanical retention.
comparison.reason: Vacuum-process control and sealing are unrelated to threaded stop calibration, despite both including a final functional check.
